**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. "I often encounter clock/calendar aptitude questions that need special formula parsing...").

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the feature should behave.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Domain / Question Category Affected:**
- [ ] Quantitative Aptitude
- [ ] Data Interpretation
- [ ] Non-Verbal & Visual Reasoning
- [ ] Logical Reasoning
- [ ] English & Verbal Ability

- [ ] UI / Overlay / Performance / Caching

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or example test questions here.
